items.quote: Highly recommend this company. They do it all! They did my entire backyard in one day. Trimmed, sprinklers, cut grass, maintenance, landscaping, re-sod grass, etc. All that & they left no mess or trail. Clean up & finished product was better then I imagined. 5 stars for sure!

Jose and his crew are awesome! They have maintained multiple properties for me over the past 15 years! Always on time, pays attention to detail, keeps the grass green and the landscaping perfect all year round.
Jose and his team did a great job. For the longest time our lawn could not grow back grass from lack of sprinklers. Jose installed quality sod and even leveled off our soil. Highly recommend.

This family-owned business did an outstanding job! They repaired my sprinklers, fixed a leaking pipe, and fertilized my lawn, all at great prices. I'm really pleased with their service and will definitely be using them again.
